title: Cosmic Storyteller
description: A jolly, heavyset man with a long beard sits on ancient stone steps wearing a vibrant multicolored patchwork robe. He gestures welcomingly toward a large ethereal blue dragon swirling around a glowing green portal in a cosmic pink and purple sky, while a procession of riders on horseback approaches through a ruined city adorned with blooming pink and purple flowers.
prompt: A cheerful obese man with a long curly beard and colorful patchwork robe sits on stone steps in an ancient ruined city street filled with pink and purple flowers. He gestures with one hand toward a giant ethereal blue dragon swirling around a glowing green and blue cosmic portal in a vibrant pink and purple starry sky. A procession of riders on horses approaches from behind, dramatic cinematic lighting, sparkling particles, highly detailed fantasy scene.
